numbering_policy: Never renumber or reuse IDs; add substeps or append new IDs with a versioned amendment.
dependency_semantics: IDs are stable tracking identifiers, not a strict chronological schedule. Step13/14 pilot milestones precede Step12 bulk; their full-data completion follows Step12.
changes_before_freeze: Step5 renamed from checkpoint driver to archive inventory/import.
Step9 explicitly names constraint implementation; definitions freeze in Step1.
Step16 renamed to model selection/final model freeze; selection policy freezes in Step1.
